oracle.efficient: Sort both arrays and merge all equal-distance groups. Start at d=0 with (3n,3m); subtract one per throw when d reaches its distance, then lexicographically maximize (a-b,a). Includes all-two endpoint. O(n log n+m log m) time and O(n+m) space.
oracle.independentBrute: Enumerate every d=0..3 on every ordered array of length1..4 over {1,2,3}; count each throw literally without prefix counts or sorted sweeps. Also 500 fixed-seed dense cases over d=0..25, 200 sparse cases at all change points, and every authored pair including maxima.
